messages.author: f94ecb93a2346fa9
messages.subject: ShinyApps.io and Iframes
parts:
Hi and thanks for a daily-use application! 

Until recently, I used to be able to load my ShinyApps via Iframes (in bootstraps handy modal windows). 
Not any more. 

Is this a security change from your side?

If so, do you have any suggestion on incorporating the Shiny apps with other related files (i.e. other Rmd, Md and files rendered as a project site)?


Many thanks,
Vasilios

messages.author: f94ecb93a2346fa9
messages.subject: Re: ShinyApps.io and Iframes
parts:
Sorry my mistake - it wasn't the Iframe's fault (though the log throughs cross-domain warnings). 
It does actually load plain.

I was trying to POST the login credentials through it, but without success. 
Is there a reason why this should not work do you think?
Alternatively, is there a way to pre-populate the login form - allowing the user to send the form? 

There are good reasons for this setup in our environment, but I can understand if this is not possible due to security issues.

Thanks again,
Vasilios

messages.author: f94ecb93a2346fa9
messages.subject: Re: ShinyApps.io and Iframes
parts:
To add, 

It appears if your Shinyapp requires a login - this can't be done through the iframe. 
An incorrect user/password is recognized and alerted to. 
But a correct one just reloads the same login screen without passing you through to the app. 

If you log in to the app in a separate browser window, and then access it through the iframe everything works fine. 

/Vasilios
